intro: With the tower's defenses awake, Skuerto at Refuge Pointe sends you into the ogre-held tower for Trelane's phylactery, orb and ember agate. They should lie in chests inside, and Skuerto says Malin will be more than pleased if you bring them back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here's what your lookin' for: Trelane's phylactery, Trelane's orb, an' Trelane's ember agate.
All three should be in chests within the tower an' you shouldn't have a problem opening the chests on your own; you just have to be careful of the ogres.

The tower's defenses won't take care of 'em on their own; you'll need to have your weapons at the ready. Those ogres find out you're there and stealing from 'em, an' they'll be sure to put the hurt on you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You do this, an' I'm sure Malin'll be more than pleased with you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Malin couldn't've asked a worthier person to come here an' aid us, friend. You've done a grand job!
He'll be pleased to see what an overwhelming success our mission's been.
